ed_support: Hey team — cust ACME reports embeddings shape changed after they pinned a model variant this morning. They used /v2/embeddings with model=redwood/embed-x512:2026-03-01 and now get vectors of length 256.
sam_cust: Confirmed. API returns 256-length arrays for new calls. Old calls before pin still return 512 for same customer key.
ed_support: Oof. Do we have the request payload and headers from the customer? They sent an example.
sam_cust: Payload:
```
POST /v2/embeddings
{ "model": "redwood/embed-x512:2026-03-01", "input": ["hello world","acct id 123"], "batch_size": 2 }
```
Response shows two arrays each length 256.
anna_prodeng: Is the pinned variant aliasing to an older quantized checkpoint? Any variant substitutions in routing? ml_sre: I see a recent pin operation at 4898761200 for their account to variant embed-x512-quant-v2.
ed_support: Customer says they pinned the hosted variant via console -> pinned versions UI at 08:02 UTC. That matches your timestamp.
ml_sre: Quick repro on staging with that variant: single input calls return 512, batching (n>1) returns 256. Reproduced locally.
anna_prodeng: Interesting — batching-only. Could be a batchpad/truncation path incorrectly selecting a model flavor with different vec size. Any caching or fallback rules that choose a different variant for batched requests?
ml_sre: Routing logs: for batch requests we route to pooled worker pool with fallback mapping to embed-x256-compat when compatibility flag set. Looks like pinned variant didn't propagate to pooled pool config.
ed_support: Customer is blocked in production. They rely on 512-size embeddings for downstream index. Suggested workaround?
anna_prodeng: Short term: advise them to set batch_size=1 or unpin the variant. Longer: we need a fix to ensure pinned variant is honored for both single and batched paths.
sam_cust: Batch_size=1 is a non-starter for them (throughput). They prefer unpin while we investigate.
ml_sre: I'll open a hotfix immediately to force consistent variant mapping in the batching router. Deploy-bot: deploy requested: hotfix/ensure-pinned-variant-batching -> staging -> canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 4898765440. Health checks passing.
anna_prodeng: Also collect a minimal repro from the customer: headers (x-customer-pin, model, request-id) + a curl we can run.
ed_support: Got it, asking for request-id and consent to run test on their data.
sam_cust: Provided sample request-id r-ACME-9182 and gave permission.
ml_sre: Running against canary now.
ml_sre: Canary returns 512 for batched request r-ACME-9182. Looks fixed in canary.
ed_support: I'll tell the customer we have a canary fix and offer to unpin on their behalf or wait for full rollout.
sam_cust: Please unpin for now and we'll monitor. Thanks.
anna_prodeng: Follow-up: add an integration test covering pinned variants + batching + pooling to prevent regression.
ed_support: Noted — will track as internal ticket INF-1129.
ml_sre: Adding logs + postmortem once GA deploy completes. :thumbsup:
